reviews.comment: Great professor and clearly passionate on math that is contagious. Gives tons of bonus points on exams, which are almost identical to homework problems. Do the optional homework problems and you will easily max out on the frqs. Weekly quizzes are pretty free too if you can memorize definitions.
reviews.ratingTags: Inspirational

reviews.comment: Charming French dude.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Good lecturer.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Excellent lectures, and his English is solid. I usually ask professors many questions both during and after the class. He kindly answered all my questions and made sure I understood them. Make sure to use office hours to your benefit. Overall, do not hesitate to take him.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great prof. Pretty easy class tbh. Proofs are pretty hard and abstract, but pay attention and ask questions. Side note - Proof by: "Trust me bro" is NOT a valid proof - do not write on exams.

Left me awestruck and speechless after every lecture with the ability to convey complex topics so clearly. Helped me to discover what higher level math really is and made me fall in love with it. I also managed to fall in love with him. This man is inspirational.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Inspirational

reviews.comment: My hero. Even though he's famous he always takes time for his fans. What a boss. 10/10 would recommend. I would die for Baudier. Love his fashion. Big French vibes.
reviews.ratingTags: Inspirational--Hilarious--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the best professor I ve ever had. He made the class so easy to learn. 2 quizzes every week that help to keep track on the class. Exams re straight from H W and the note. H W is not graded. I spent about 10 mins to review for each quiz, and 2-3 hours for the tests,including the final. Tip is try to understand rather than memorize the material
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Not gonna lie, his class is not easy, but I wholeheartedly believe that the difficulty came from the material and not his teaching. Homework is optional, but his quizzes are a question directly from the homework, and usually have a theorem that you need to write verbatim. Honestly, study for about 3 hours a week and you should be just fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Baudier knows his material well, but he is very hard to follow. He skips over steps expecting you already know them which can make it very difficult to keep up. You can get an A in this class, but it will take a lot of outside studying.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I rarely went to class because going only made me frustrated. I wish he would dumb down his lectures a bit, he's hard to understand and he over-complicates things, but it's because hes really intelligent. I made an A just by reading the book and watching youtube videos. He is a nice guy and doesn't want you to fail. Also he's hot.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: If you're expecting this class to be easy, it won't. It is the most challenging calculus 2 course at A&M. At the beginning of this class it will seem like there is no way you will pass but you will adjust. He is a little hard to understand, and he makes you learn the theorems, not just know how to do the math. However, you will learn a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: 220 is relatively a hard subject to teach, but he explains it well. Sometimes his homework is a bit hard and probably not covered in class yet. He gives examples but in my opinion not clear enough. The book, khan academy and other youtube videos help a lot. Very accessible outside of class and will help if you ask! Be ready for tons of notes!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Baudier is a very bland professor. He teaches concept and tests application, which makes it difficult to study. The only grades for the semester are weekly quizzes and 3 exams (including the final) which are 75% of your grade. He is not very flexible with helping you out grade wise. he is hard to understand because he has a thick French accent.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I did great in all my calculus class before 172. it is a very difficult class, but study and really try to understand the theorems.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Wish he taught more classes I could take.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Teaches like the students already have a degree in math. Only speaks in proofs and theroems and almost never shows examples or problems. Half the grade on quizzes is just memorizing a series of words that dont prove your mastering in the subject whatsoever. Terrible professor, hope you have money to hire a tutor to actually teach you everything.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Put away your phone, it will not fly. His accent was too thick for me to get past. He was more focused on giving proofs then working the actual problems. Skip lecture and find a better one if you absolutely have to take his class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class was hard and Mr. Baudier made it harder. He jumped around every topic during each lecture, and made each topic more difficult then I feel it had to be. Also, his grading on the free response portions of the test was way to difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Baudier only explains the theory behind problems and even those explanations are not very clear.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Baudier is one of the best professors I've had at A&M. 220 is a really hard class but he made it really meaningful and I took away way more from the class than I expected. He cares about you actually learning and understanding the material unlike some of my profs. His tests and quizzes were always fair, no surprises. Would definitely recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: He can be hard to understand at times. He will call you out for talking in class and he hates phones or computers. Uses the whiteboard and stands in front of the notes a lot (frustrating).
Amazing professor. Would definitely recommend for any math course. His tests can be challenging but he teaches you more than enough to succeed on them if you go to class

Very fair professor with the ability to give an effective lecture. His tests and quizzes are straightforward. I recommend studying past ones on his website. Attendance isn't mandatory but recommended, because his lectures are helpful. The homework also is optional, yet recommended.

Gives good examples in class. Can sometimes lose you by going fast or from his moderate accent. In class quizzes are not bad, can be found online. Tests are very hard. He is a very strict grader, gives almost no partial credit. He really does not want to curve despite awful test averages. Attendance is not mandatory, but recommended.
He gives quizzes based off of the homework he assigns. He explains everything very well & most of the time the questions on the exam were examples given in lecture. Show up to class & it's an easy A!

He substituted for a portion of my analysis course, i really wish i would have had the opportunity to take a full class from him. He made everything so easy to understand! I never had any questions because he explained everything so well the first time around.
GREAT PROFESSOR. Tests are not hard compared to the other 251 teachers. Homework is of course on webassign. Very nice professor! Fair also!

I loved this professor. His accent was hard to get used to at first, but it really wasn't that bad. He spent a lot of time explaining why certain theories and equations worked. He was very helpful outside of class and encouraged students to visit him during office hours. He is one of the better engineering math teachers and I highly recommend him.
